candidates.formal_type:
∀ {k : Type u_4} [inst : Field.{u_4} k] {A : Type u_5} [inst_1 : Ring.{u_5} A] [inst_2 : Algebra.{u_4, u_5} k A]
  {V : Type u_6} [inst_3 : AddCommGroup.{u_6} V] [inst_4 : Module.{u_4, u_6} k V] [inst_5 : Module.{u_5, u_6} A V]
  [inst_6 : IsScalarTower.{u_4, u_5, u_6} k A V] [FiniteDimensional.{u_4, u_6} k V] [IsAlgClosed.{u_4} k],
  Etingof.IsIndecomposable.{u_5, u_6} A V →
    Exists.{u_6 + 1} fun S =>
      And (IsSimpleModule.{u_5, u_6} A (Subtype.{u_6 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_6, u_6} S x))
        (Exists.{max (u_4 + 1) (u_5 + 1)} fun χ_V =>
          And
            (∀ (z : Subtype.{u_5 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_5, u_5} (Subalgebra.center.{u_4, u_5} k A) x),
              IsNilpotent.{u_6}
                (HSub.hSub.{u_6, u_6, u_6} (Etingof.centralAction.{u_4, u_5, u_6} z)
                  (HSMul.hSMul.{u_4, u_6, u_6} (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_4 + 1) (u_5 + 1), u_5 + 1, u_4 + 1} χ_V z) 1)))
            (∀ (z : Subtype.{u_5 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_5, u_5} (Subalgebra.center.{u_4, u_5} k A) x)
              (s : Subtype.{u_6 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_6, u_6} S x),
              Eq.{u_6 + 1} (HSMul.hSMul.{u_5, u_6, u_6} (Subtype.val.{u_5 + 1} z) (Subtype.val.{u_6 + 1} s))
                (HSMul.hSMul.{u_4, u_6, u_6} (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_4 + 1) (u_5 + 1), u_5 + 1, u_4 + 1} χ_V z)
                  (Subtype.val.{u_6 + 1} s))))
